显著性检验的共同流程
The Common Workflow of Significance Testing

1 学习目标
1 Learning Goals

Page 1
  1. Be able to list the steps common to all null hypothesis significance tests.
  2. Be able to define and compute the probability of Type I and Type II errors.
  3. Be able to look up and apply one- and two-sample t-tests.

本讲有三个目标: 说出 NHST 的共同步骤; 会计算两类错误的概率; 能查阅并应用单样本和双样本 t 检验.

重点是识别检验结构, 不是死背公式. 看到一种新检验时, 应能找出数据假设、统计量、零分布和尾概率.

学习每个例题时, 可以沿着同一条路线复述: 为什么选这个检验, 统计量怎样算, 拒绝域在哪一侧, 最后结论依赖哪些模型条件.

2 引言
2 Introduction

Page 1

We continue our study of significance tests. In these notes we will introduce two new tests: one-sample t-tests and two-sample t-tests. You should pay careful attention to the fact that every test makes some assumptions about the data – often that is drawn from a normal distribution. You should also notice that all the tests follow the same pattern. It is just the computation of the test statistic and the type of the null distribution that changes.

本讲把上一讲的框架用于 **one-sample t-test 单样本 t 检验**和 **two-sample t-test 双样本 t 检验**. 检验形式不变, 变化的是统计量、零分布及其成立条件.

每种检验都对数据作假设, 常见的是正态、独立和方差条件. 公式可以查, 但在套用前必须判断这些条件是否合理.

3.1 设计并运行显著性检验
3.1 Setting up and running a significance test

Pages 1–2

There is a fairly standard set of steps one takes to set up and run a null hypothesis significance test.

  1. Design an experiment to collect data and choose a test statistic x to be computed from the data. The key requirement here is to know the null distribution ϕ(x∣H0​). To compute power, one must also know the alternative distribution ϕ(x∣HA​).
  2. Decide if the test is one or two-sided based on HA​ and the form of the null distribution.
  3. Choose a significance level α for rejecting the null hypothesis.
  4. Decide how much data you need to collect to achieve the desired power for the test.

前四步都发生在看数据之前. 先设计实验并选统计量, 必须知道它的零分布; 若要评估功效, 还要知道具体备择分布.

然后按备择方向决定单双尾, 预先选定 α, 再按目标功效估计样本量. 这些步骤防止看完结果后临时改变规则.

实验设计还包括怎样抽样、分组和测量. 若这些环节破坏了独立性或引入偏差, 后面的统计公式再正确也不能自动修复数据问题.

功效计算必须针对一个有意义的备择效应, 例如「均值至少相差多少」. 只说「希望功效高」而不给备择分布, 仍然无法确定样本量.

Page 2
  1. Run the experiment to collect data x1​,x2​,…,xn​.
  2. Compute the test statistic x.
  3. Compute the p-value corresponding to x using the null distribution.
  4. If p<α, reject the null hypothesis in favor of the alternative hypothesis.

后四步才是收集数据、计算统计量、用零分布计算 p 值并作决定.

易错:不能只记住最后的 p<α. 若事先不知道零分布, p 值无从计算; 若事先不设备择分布, 也无法评估功效.

流程说明
Notes.

Page 2
  1. Rather than choosing a significance level, you could instead choose a rejection region and reject H0​ if x falls in this region. The corresponding significance level is then the probability, assuming H0​, that x falls in the rejection region.
  2. The null hypothesis is often the ‘cautious hypothesis’. The lower we set the significance level, the more “evidence” we will require before rejecting our cautious hypothesis in favor of a more sensational alternative. It is standard practice to publish the p value itself so that others may draw their own conclusions.

可以先选 α 再确定拒绝域, 也可以先确定拒绝域, 再用零分布计算它的显著性. 两种起点最终都给出同一个决策规则.

α 越小, 拒绝谨慎原假设所需的证据越强. 报告实际 p 值则让读者能按自己的门槛判断, 而不是只知道「通过或未通过 0.05」.

但降低 α 并非没有代价. 在其他条件不变时, 更严格的拒绝标准往往减少真实效应被检出的机会, 所以还应同时查看功效, 而不是一味追求更小的显著性水平.

Page 2
  1. A key point of confusion: A significance level of 0.05 does not mean the test only makes mistakes 5% of the time. It means that if the null hypothesis is true, then the probability the test will mistakenly reject it is 5%. The power of the test measures the accuracy of the test when the alternative hypothesis is true. Namely, the power of the test is the probability of rejecting the null hypothesis if the alternative hypothesis is true. Therefore the probability of falsely failing to reject the null hypothesis is 1 minus the power.
  2. Another key point of confusion: We use p-values, but conceptually the p-value is just a computational trick. After choosing a test statistic, the conceptual order is: first pick a significance level, then use this to define the rejection region. We reject the null hypothesis if the test statistic is in the rejection region. All the p-value does is tell us in one computation whether or not the test stastic is in the rejection region.

0.05 不表示所有决定中只有 5% 出错, 而是 H0​ 为真时误拒它的概率为 5%. HA​ 为真时的漏检概率由 1−power 决定, 是另一个条件概率.

p 值是判断统计量是否落入拒绝域的计算工具. 概念上仍是先定 α 和拒绝域, 不是看完 p 值后临时选门槛.

两类错误分别在不同现实条件下评价同一规则. 因此「所有实验中 5% 出错」「显著结果中 5% 是误判」「不拒绝结果中 5% 是漏检」都不是 α=0.05 的含义.

报告 p 值可以保留更多证据信息, 但不能用它替代效应大小、模型检查和功效分析.

原文笔误:Notes 第 4 点的 test stastic 应为 test statistic. 后文 probabilitiy 应为 probability, 两处 signficance 应为 significance.

Page 2

Errors. We can summarize these two types of errors and their probabilities as follows:

Type I error = rejecting H0​ when H0​ is true.
Type II error = failing to reject H0​ when HA​ is true.

P(type I error)P(type II error)​=P(test statistic is in the rejection region∣H0​)=significance level of the test,=P(test statistic is in the acceptance region∣HA​)=1−power.​

Helpful analogies. In terms of medical testing for a disease: a Type I error is a false positive and a Type II error is a false negative. In a jury trial, a Type I error is convicting an innocent defendant and a Type II error is acquitting a guilty defendant.

**type I error 第一类错误**是误拒真实的 H0​, 也叫假阳性; **type II error 第二类错误**是 HA​ 为真时未拒绝 H0​, 也叫假阴性.

显著性水平只控制第一类错误. 医学筛查与法庭类比都帮助记忆, 但计算时仍要按条件方向区分「真实情况」和「检验决定」.

4 理解一项显著性检验
4 Understanding a significance test

Page 3

Questions to ask:

  1. How did they collect data? What is the experimental setup?
  2. What are the null and alternative hypotheses?
  3. What type of significance test was used? Does the data match the criteria needed to use this type of test? How robust is the test to deviations from these criteria?
  4. For example, some tests comparing two groups of data assume that the groups are drawn from distributions that have the same variance. This needs to be verified before applying the test. Often the check is done using another significance test designed to compare the variances of two groups of data.
  5. How is the p-value computed? A significance test comes with a test statistic and a null distribution. In most tests the p-value is
    p=P(data at least as extreme as what we got∣H0​).
    What does ‘data at least as extreme as the data we saw’ mean? For example, is the test one or two-sided?
  6. What is the significance level α for this test? If p<α then the experimenter will reject H0​ in favor of HA​.
  7. What is the power of the test?

阅读检验报告时, 先问数据怎样产生、模型假设是否合理, 再看统计量和 p 值. **robustness 稳健性**指假设略有偏离时, 检验结论是否仍大致可靠.

等方差双样本 t 检验要求两组总体方差相同, 这个条件不是公式自动保证的. 还要问极端方向、显著性和具体备择下的功效, 才能完整理解结论.

独立性也要从实验设计判断: 同一人的重复测量、兄弟姐妹或互相影响受试者, 未必能当作彼此独立的观察. 仅看直方图无法发现这类问题.

如果用另一个检验检查方差或正态性, 也要理解它同样有假设和功效限制. 「检验没有拒绝等方差」不等于已经证明方差完全相同.

两类错误与检验功效
Types of Error and Power

3.2 功效
3.2 Power

Pages 2–3

We discussed power in the Class 17 notes. Power is the probabilitiy of correctly rejecting the null hypothesis. It depends on the alternative hypothesis HA​ being considered. The ideal test has power equal to 1.0 and significance equal to 0.0. Of course, in general, this is impossible. And we want to find some compromise where power is high and signficance is low.

In symbols: power=P(data is in the rejection region∣HA​).

Compare this with: signficance=P(data is in the rejection region∣H0​).

**power 检验功效**是在具体备择分布下正确拒绝 H0​ 的概率. 显著性和功效都对同一个拒绝域求概率, 区别只在条件分布分别是 H0​ 和 HA​.

理想情况当然希望 α 很小、功效很大, 但固定样本下往往需要折中. 复合备择包含许多参数值, 报功效时必须说明在哪个参数下.

Slide 11
True state of nature
Our decisionH0​ is trueHA​ is true
Reject H0​Type I errorcorrect decision
Don’t reject H0​correct decisionType II error

Significance level =P(type I error) = probability we incorrectly reject H0​ =P(test statistic in rejection region∣H0​)=P(false positive).

Power = probability we correctly reject H0​ =P(test statistic in rejection region∣HA​)=1−P(type II error)=P(true positive).

  • HA​ determines the power of the test.
  • Significance and power are both probabilities of the rejection region.
  • Want significance level near 0 and power near 1.

决策表的两列不能混读: 第一列概率以 H0​ 为条件, 第二列以 HA​ 为条件. α 不是所有决定中的错误比例, 功效也不是拒绝后 HA​ 为真的概率.

假阳性与真阳性都对应「拒绝」, 但分别在不同事实列中计算. 这张表把后面的所有概率公式统一起来.

同理, HA​ 为真且不拒绝是假阴性, 其概率为 1−power; H0​ 为真且不拒绝则是正确决定. 先锁定列再读行, 就不会把显著性与功效放反.

显著性与功效课堂题
Table question: significance level and power

Slide 12

Our data x follows a binomial(θ,10) distribution with θ unknown. The rejection region is boxed in orange. The corresponding probabilities for different hypotheses are shaded below it.

x012345678910
H0​:p(x∣θ=0.5)0.0010.0100.0440.1170.2050.2460.2050.1170.0440.010.001
HA​:p(x∣θ=0.6)0.0000.0020.0110.0420.1110.2010.2510.2150.1210.0400.006
HA​:p(x∣θ=0.7)0.0000.0000.0010.0090.0370.1030.2000.2670.2330.1210.028

(a) Find the significance level of the test.
(b) Find the power of the test for each of the two alternative hypotheses.
(c) What is the probability of a type I error? type II?

橙色拒绝域是 {0,1,2,8,9,10}. 在 θ=0.5 行求和, 显著性与第一类错误概率都是 0.109375≈0.11.

按表中三位小数, 两个备择的功效约为 0.180 和 0.383; 用精确二项概率则为 0.1795843 和 0.3843732. 后者写三位小数应为 0.384, 差别来自表内先四舍五入.

第二类错误概率为 1−power, 按精确值分别约为 0.820416 和 0.615627.

读表时每一问都先选正确的行, 再对同一组橙色列求和. 不要把不同参数行的概率混合, 也不要把中间的观察值概率当成拒绝域概率.

若要保留更多位数, 应从未舍入的二项概率开始计算. 先把每格压成三位小数再相加, 会产生小的累计舍入差, 这就是 0.383 与 0.384 的差别.

幻灯片错误:题干写 binomial(θ,10), 参数顺序与本课程一贯写法及表中概率不符. 正确应为 binomial(10,θ), 即 10 次试验、成功概率为 θ.

The power of the test in the graph is given by the area of

  1. R1​
  2. R2​
  3. R1​+R2​
  4. R1​+R2​+R3​

选 (c) R1​+R2​. 功效沿备择曲线 ϕ(x∣HA​) 在拒绝域内积分.

R3​ 虽与拒绝域相邻, 但位于不拒绝域, 不计入功效. 算概率要同时看曲线属于哪个假设和横轴属于哪个区域.

Which of the tests below has higher power?

(1) Top graph   (2) Bottom graph

选 (2) 下图. 两图拒绝域相同, 但下图备择分布几乎全部落在拒绝域内, 功效接近 1.

上图有大量备择概率落在不拒绝域, 第二类错误更多. 功效比较的不是曲线高低的视觉效果, 而是拒绝域下的实际面积.

Slide 15

The null distribution for test statistic x is N(4,82). The rejection region is {x≥20}.

What is the significance level and power of this test?

(Full solution posted with solutions to today’s problems.)

临界值 20 比零分布均值 4 高 2 个标准差, 所以 α=P(X≥20∣H0​)=P(Z≥2)≈0.02275, 按正态经验法则可约为 0.025.

缺的信息:题目没有给备择分布, 因此无法算功效. 只知道 H0​ 和拒绝域, 只能确定第一类错误概率.

要补算功效, 必须给出例如 HA​:X∼N(μA​,82) 的具体均值 μA​. 然后在该备择分布下计算 P(X≥20), 而不是继续沿 N(4,82) 求面积.

这正体现了显著性与功效所需信息不同: 零分布加拒绝域足够算前者, 后者还需要明确的备择模型.

拒绝域、临界值与 p 值
Rejection Regions, Critical Values and p-values

理解拒绝域图
Understand this figure

Slide 3
  • x = test statistic
  • ϕ(x∣H0​) = pdf of null distribution = blue curve
  • Rejection region is a portion of the x-axis.
  • Significance = probability of rejection = orange shaded area.

拒绝域是统计量数轴上的集合, 不是曲线下方的某块区域本身; 曲线下面积给出落入该集合的概率.

双尾图中两块橙色面积之和才是 α. 横轴回答「哪些结果拒绝」, 面积回答「这些结果在 H0​ 下有多可能」.

Slide 4

Simple hypothesis: the sampling distribution is fully specified. Usually the parameter of interest has a specific value.

Composite hypotheses: the sampling distribution is not fully specified. Usually the parameter of interest has a range of values.

Example. A coin has probability θ of heads. Toss it 30 times and let x be the number of heads.
(i) H:θ=0.4 is simple. x∼binomial(30,0.4).
(ii) H:θ>0.4 is composite. x∼binomial(30,θ) depends on which value of θ is chosen.

**simple hypothesis 简单假设**唯一确定抽样分布; **composite hypothesis 复合假设**只限定参数范围, 仍含一族分布.

θ=0.4 可直接给出一张概率表, θ>0.4 则必须指定具体 θ 才能计算功效或其他分布性质.

Slide 5

Hypotheses: H0​,HA​.

Test statistic: value: x, computed from data, random.

Null distribution: ϕ(x∣H0​) (assumes null hypothesis is true)

Sides: HA​ determines if the rejection region is one or two-sided.

Rejection region/Significance: P(x in rejection region∣H0​)=α.

The p-value is a computational tool to check if the test statistic is in the rejection region. It is also a measure of the evidence for rejecting H0​.

p-value: P(data at least as extreme as x∣H0​)

“Data at least as extreme”: determined by the sidedness of the rejection region.

p 值是在 H0​ 下至少同样极端结果的概率. 「极端」不是离 0 越远越好, 而由备择方向和拒绝域定义.

右尾检验看更大的值, 左尾看更小的值, 对称双尾看绝对值更大的值. 它提供与临界值判据等价的拒绝证据尺度.

Slide 6

Example. Suppose we have the right-sided rejection region shown below. Also suppose we see data with test statistic x=4.2. Should we reject H0​?

Solution: The test statistic is in the rejection region, so reject H0​.

Alternatively: blue striped area < orange shaded area
Significance: α=P(x in rejection region∣H0​) = orange shaded area.
p-value: p=P(data at least as extreme as x∣H0​) = blue striped area.
Since p<α we reject H0​.

x=4.2 位于临界值 cα​ 右侧. 从 4.2 开始的右尾面积小于从 cα​ 开始的右尾面积, 所以 p<α.

因此「统计量在拒绝域」和「p<α」给出同一个拒绝结论.

Slide 7

Example. Now suppose x=2.1 as shown. Should we reject H0​?

Solution: Test statistic not in the rejection region: don’t reject H0​.

Alternatively: blue area > orange shaded area
Significance: α=P(x in rejection region∣H0​) = orange shaded area.
p-value: p=P(data at least as extreme as x∣H0​) = blue striped area.
Since p>α we don’t reject H0​.

x=2.1 在拒绝域外, 其右尾包含整个橙色区域和额外一段, 因而 p>α.

结论是「不拒绝」, 不是「证明 H0​ 正确」. 数据只是没有达到预设的反对证据标准.

Slide 8
  • The boundaries of the rejection region are called critical values.
  • Critical values are labeled by the probability to their right.
  • They are complementary to quantiles: e.g., c0.1​=q0.9​.
  • Example: for a standard normal c0.025​=1.96 and c0.975​=−1.96. For standard normal we will usually use z0.025​ instead of c0.025​.
  • In R, for a standard normal c0.025​=qnorm(0.975).

**critical value 临界值**的下标记右尾概率, **quantile 分位点** qs​ 的下标记左尾概率, 所以 cα​=q1−α​.

标准正态右尾 2.5% 的临界值是 z0.025​=q0.975​≈1.96, 对应 R 的 `qnorm(0.975)`. 先画尾方向再选输入概率最不容易错.

Slide 9

These are trickier: what does ‘at least as extreme’ mean in this case? Remember the p-value is a tool for deciding if the test statistic is in the region. Best to look at each test individually. Here is a somewhat general rule: If the rejection region is equally split between left and right tails then

p=2min(left tail prob. of x,right tail prob. of x).

x is outside the rejection region, so p>α: do not reject H0​.

对称双尾检验把 α 平分为每尾 α/2. 先取观测值两侧较小的尾概率, 再乘 2, 得到与「是否进入双尾拒绝域」等价的 p 值.

适用边界:这条规则依赖这里的对称、等尾设置. 非对称分布或不对称拒绝域要按实际极端区域计算, 不能机械乘 2.

取较小尾概率是因为观测值总位于其中一侧; 乘 2 则把另一侧同样极端的结果也计入. 若观测值恰在右尾临界点上, 较小尾概率为 α/2, 乘 2 后正好等于 α.

因此这条公式不是任意双尾检验的定义捷径, 而是为了让 p 判据与等尾拒绝域严格对齐.

Slide 10

You collect data from an experiment and do a left-sided z-test with significance 0.1. You find the z-value is 1.8

(i) Which of the following computes the critical value for the rejection region?

  1. pnorm(0.1, 0, 1)
  2. pnorm(0.9, 0, 1)
  3. pnorm(0.95, 0, 1)
  4. pnorm(1.8, 0, 1)
  5. 1 - pnorm(1.8, 0, 1)
  6. qnorm(0.05, 0, 1)
  7. qnorm(0.1, 0, 1)
  8. qnorm(0.9, 0, 1)
  9. qnorm(0.95, 0, 1)

(ii) Which of the above computes the p-value for this experiment?
(iii) Should you reject the null hypothesis?   (a) Yes (b) No

(i) 选 (g). 左尾 10% 的临界值是 q0.1​≈−1.2816, 对应 `qnorm(0.1,0,1)`.

(ii) 选 (d). 左尾 p=P(Z≤1.8)=0.96407, 对应 `pnorm(1.8,0,1)`.

(iii) 选 (b) No. 观测值在零分布右侧, 与左尾备择方向相反, 而且 p>0.1, 不拒绝.

z 检验复习与双尾示例
z-test Review and a Two-sided Example

5 t 检验与 5.1 z 检验
5 t tests; 5.1 z-test

Page 4

Many significance tests assume that the data are drawn from a normal distribution, so before using such a test you should examine the data to see if the normality assumption is reasonable. We will describe how to do this in more detail later, but plotting a histogram is a good start. Like the z-test, the one-sample and two-sample t-tests that we consider below start from this normality assumption.

We don’t expect you to memorize all the computational details of these tests and those to follow. In real life, you have access to textbooks, google, and wikipedia; on the exam, you’ll have your notecard. Instead, you should be able to identify when a t-test is appropriate and apply this test after looking up the details and using a table or software like R.

使用正态类检验前要检查数据是否大致符合正态假设, 直方图是一个起点. 公式可以查阅, 适用条件和检验类型必须会判断.

Page 4

Let’s first review the z-test.

  • Data: we assume x1​,x2​,…,xn​∼N(μ,σ2), where μ is unknown and σ is known.
  • Null hypothesis: μ=μ0​ for some specific value μ0​
  • Test statistic:
    z=σ/n​xˉ−μ0​​=standardized mean.
  • Null distribution: ϕ(z∣H0​) is the pdf of Z∼N(0,1)
  • One-sided p-value (right side): p=P(Z≥z∣H0​)
    One-sided p-value (left side): p=P(Z≤z∣H0​)
    Two-sided p-value:
    p={2P(Z≥z)2P(Z≤z)​if z>0,if z<0.​
    Because of the symmetry of the distribution around 0, we can also write this as p=P(∣Z∣≥∣z∣). See Example 1b for the rationale for this.

**z-test z 检验**用于正态数据且总体标准差 σ 已知的情形. 标准化均值在 H0​ 下服从 N(0,1), 分母 σ/n​ 是样本均值的标准误.

单双尾由 HA​ 决定. 双尾利用标准正态关于 0 的对称性, 把较小一侧的尾概率乘 2. 使用前要检查正态假设, 公式可以查阅, 适用条件不能省.

Example 1: 右尾 z 检验
Example 1.

Pages 4–5

Suppose that we have data that follows a normal distribution of unknown mean μ and known variance 4. Let the null hypothesis H0​ be that μ=2. Let the alternative hypothesis HA​ be that μ>2. Suppose we collect the following data:

3, 2, 5, 7, 1

At a significance level of α=0.05, should we reject the null hypothesis?

Solution: There are 5 data points with average xˉ=3.6. Because we have normal data with a known variance we should use a z test. Our z statistic is

z=σ/n​xˉ−μ0​​=2/5​3.6−2​=1.79.

Our test is one-sided because the alternative hypothesis is one-sided. So (using R) our p-value is

p=P(Z>z)=P(Z>1.79)=0.037.

Since p<α=0.05, we reject the null hypothesis in favor of the alternative hypothesis that μ>2.

五个数据的均值为 3.6, 已知 σ=2, 所以 z=(3.6−2)/(2/5​)≈1.79. 右尾 p≈0.03682<0.05, 拒绝 H0​.

图中 z=1.79 也超过临界值 1.64, 两种判据一致. 拒绝方向是备择的 μ>2, 不是笼统地宣布「模型错误」.

这里已知方差 4, 所以标准差是 2, 均值标准误是 2/5​. 若误把方差 4 当作标准差代入, 分母会错误地变成 4/5​.

右尾 p 值只累计比 1.79 更大的结果, 不包括左侧对称尾部, 因为当前备择只关心均值是否更大.

Example 1b: 改为双尾
Example 1b; Reason for the factor of 2 in the computation of p

Page 5

Repeat Example 1 as a two-sided test, i.e. with HA​ being μ=2.

Solution: Let’s do the test and then we’ll explain the rationale behind the computation of the p-value.

Since z>0, p=2P(Z>z)=0.074. Since, p>α=0.05, the data does not support rejecting the null hypothesis in favor of HA​.

The reason is essentially arithmetic. Remember, the purpose of the p-value is that p≤α indicates that the test statistic is in the rejection region.

The picture below illustrates the following. For a two-sided test, each side of the rejection region has probability α/2. So, if the test statistic is on the right, then it is in the rejection region if P(Z>z)≤α/2, i.e. if p=2P(Z>z)≤α

同一数据、同一 α, 右尾备择给出 p≈0.03682, 拒绝; 双尾备择给出 p≈0.07364, 不拒绝. 差异来自研究问题不同, 不是计算矛盾.

双尾每侧只分配 α/2, 所以右尾概率要先与 0.025 比较. 乘 2 只是把这一比较恢复成与总 α 比较.

为什么不能事后换尾:若看到均值为正就把原双尾改成右尾, 会人为放大显著性.

原文笔误:Example 1b 图左说明写 −z = black dot = 1.79, 但左黑点对应 −z=−1.79. 右侧 z=1.79 与图中坐标一致, 左侧数值漏了负号.

Student t 分布与单样本检验
Student’s t Distribution and the One-sample Test

5.2 Student t 分布
5.2 The Student t distribution

Pages 5–6

‘Student’ is the pseudonym used by the William Gosset who first described this test and distribution. See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Student's_t-test

The t-distribution is symmetric and bell-shaped like the normal distribution. It has a parameter df which stands for degrees of freedom. For df small the t-distribution has more probability in its tails than the standard normal distribution. As df increases t(df) becomes more and more like the standard normal distribution.

Here is a simple applet that shows t(df) and compares it to the standard normal distribution: https://mathlets.org/mathlets/t-distribution/

As degrees of freedom increases the t-distribution becomes normal

**Student’s t-distribution Student t 分布**关于 0 对称, **degrees of freedom 自由度** df 控制尾部厚度. 小自由度尾部比标准正态厚, 大自由度逐渐接近标准正态.

用样本方差代替已知方差会引入额外不确定性, 厚尾正体现这一点. 因此小样本的 t 临界值通常比相应 z 临界值更靠外.

在同样的观测统计量下, 厚尾也意味着极端尾概率往往更大. 自由度增大后, 方差估计更稳定, t 分布逐渐接近标准正态, 两种检验的差别随之缩小.

尾部厚度不表示分布偏斜: t 分布仍关于 0 对称, 双尾概率仍可利用左右对称计算.

原文笔误:Student 段 the William Gosset 应删去 the; 图下 As degrees of freedom increases 应为 As degrees of freedom increase. R 段末尾 t(3)) 多一个右括号.

5.3 R 中的 t 函数
5.3 R

Page 6

As usual in R, the functions pt, dt, qt, rt correspond to cdf, pdf, quantiles, and random sampling for a t distribution. Remember that you can type ?dt in RStudio to view the help file specifying the parameters of dt. For example, pt(1.65,3) computes the probability that x is less than or equal 1.65 given that x is sampled from the t distribution with 3 degrees of freedom, i.e. P(x≤1.65) given that x∼t(3)).

R 中 `pt`、`dt`、`qt`、`rt` 分别对应 CDF、PDF、分位点和随机抽样. `pt(1.65,3)` 给出 t3​ 在 1.65 左侧的累计概率.

右尾概率用 1−pt, 临界值用 `qt`. 本讲涉及的 t 尾概率用 Python 数值积分核对, 未运行 R.

`pt` 与 `qt` 的方向相反: 前者输入统计量、输出累计概率, 后者输入累计概率、输出分位点. 求观测 p 值通常用 `pt`, 求拒绝域边界通常用 `qt`.

5.4 单样本 t 检验
5.4 One sample t-test

Pages 6–7

For the z-test, we assumed that the variance of the underlying distribution of the data was known. However, it is often the case that we don’t know σ and therefore we must estimate it from the data. In these cases, we use a one sample t-test instead of a z-test and the studentized mean in place of the standardized mean

  • Data: we assume x1​,x2​,…,xn​∼N(μ,σ2), where both μ and σ are unknown.
  • Null hypothesis: μ=μ0​ for some specific value μ0​
  • Test statistic:
    t=s/n​xˉ−μ0​​,s2=n−11​i=1∑n​(xi​−xˉ)2.
    Here t is called the Studentized mean and s2 is called the sample variance. The latter is an estimate of the true variance σ2.
  • Null distribution: ϕ(t∣H0​) is the pdf of T∼t(n−1), the t distribution with n−1 degrees of freedom.*
  • One-sided p-value (right side): p=P(T≥t∣H0​)
    One-sided p-value (left side): p=P(T≤t∣H0​)
    Two-sided p-value:
    p={2P(T≥t)2P(T≤t)​if t>0,if t<0.​
    Because of the symmetry of the distribution around 0, we can also write this as p=P(∣T∣≥∣t∣).

总体方差未知时, 用样本方差 s2 估计 σ2, 标准化均值就变成 **Studentized mean 学生化均值**. 在正态独立样本和 H0​ 下, 它服从 t(n−1).

样本方差分母用 n−1, 所以自由度也是 n−1. 之后算尾概率的步骤与 z 检验完全一样, 只是查 t 分布而不是标准正态.

计算时先由数据得到 xˉ 和 s2, 再把 s/n​ 作为均值标准误. 不要把 s2 直接放进分母的平方根外, 否则会多除或少除一次样本量.

若 σ 真正已知, 就应使用已知值做 z 检验; 只有需要由同一份样本估计方差时, 才换成学生化均值和 t 分布.

Page 7

*Important note. This is a good example of how we will work with significance tests. Once we know the distribution of the test statistic, all the tests have the same basic form. In this case, we make use of a theorem that says, for normal data the Studentized mean follows a t-distribution. We will not prove this in 18.05, but you can look up the proof if you want: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Student's_t-distribution#Derivation

这里引用了一个定理: 正态独立样本的学生化均值服从 t 分布. 本课不证明它, 但知道零分布后, 后续的拒绝域、临界值和 p 值都能按统一流程完成.

Example 2: 方差未知
Example 2.

Page 7

Now suppose that in Example 1 the variance is unknown. That is, we have data that follows a normal distribution of unknown mean μ and and unknown variance σ. Suppose we collect the same data as before:

1, 2, 3, 6, −1

As above, let the null hypothesis H0​ be that μ=0 and the alternative hypothesis HA​ be that μ>0. At a significance level of α=0.05, should we reject the null hypothesis?

Solution: There are 5 data points with average xˉ=2.2. Because we have normal data with unknown mean and unknown variance we should use a one-sample t test. Computing the sample variance we get

s2=41​((1−2.2)2+(2−2.2)2+(3−2.2)2+(6−2.2)2+(−1−2.2)2)=6.7.

Our t-statistic is the Studentized mean:

t=s/n​xˉ−μ0​​=6.7​/5​2.2−0​=1.901.

Our test is one-sided because the alternative hypothesis is one-sided. So (using R) the p-value is

p=P(T>t)=P(T>1.901)=1-pt(1.901,4)=0.065.

Since p>0.05, we do not reject the null hypothesis.

这组数据的 xˉ=2.2, s2=6.7, df=4, 所以 t=2.2/6.7/5​≈1.9005. 右尾 p≈0.06508>0.05, 不拒绝.

图中临界值 t0.05​≈2.13, 观测值 1.90 仍在不拒绝域. 与 Example 1 的结论不同并不奇怪: 数据、H0​ 和方差信息都已改变.

原文笔误:Example 2 写 the same data as before, 但 Example 1 是 3, 2, 5, 7, 1, 这里实际改成 1, 2, 3, 6, −1, H0​ 也从 μ=2 改成 μ=0. 应按新数据和新假设理解. 同段 and and 重复; unknown variance \(\sigma\) 应为 unknown variance \(\sigma^2\).

z 与单样本 t 检验课堂题
Board question: z and one-sample t-test

Slide 18

For both problems use significance level α=0.05.

Assume the data 2, 4, 4, 10 are independently drawn from a N(μ,σ2).

The hypotheses are: H0​:μ=0 and HA​:μ=0.

(a) Is the test one or two-sided? If one-sided, which side?
(b) Assume σ2=16 is known and test H0​ against HA​.
(c) Now assume σ2 is unknown and test H0​ against HA​.

(a) HA​:μ=0, 所以双尾. 数据给出 xˉ=5, s2=(9+1+1+25)/3=12.

(b) 已知 σ=4, z=5/(4/4​)=2.5. 双尾拒绝域为 ∣z∣≥1.96, p≈0.012419, 拒绝.

(c) 方差未知时 t=5/12/4​=5/3​≈2.88675, df=3. 双尾 p≈0.063180>0.05, 不拒绝. 小样本估计方差使 t3​ 尾部更厚, 因而结论不同.

两问使用相同数据和备择, 唯一实质差别是方差信息. 已知 σ2=16 提供了额外确定性, 方差未知则只能依赖只有 3 个自由度的估计.

这不是 z 检验永远更容易显著, 而是本例在小样本、厚尾和双尾条件下的结果. 大样本时两种方法通常会接近.

等方差双样本 t 检验
The Two-sample t-test with Equal Variances

5.5 等方差双样本 t 检验
5.5 Two-sample t-test with equal variances

Page 8

We next consider the case of comparing the means of two samples. For example, we might be interested in comparing the mean efficacies of two medical treatments.

  • Data: We assume we have two sets of data drawn from normal distributions
    x1​,x2​,…,xn​∼N(μ1​,σ2),y1​,y2​,…,ym​∼N(μ2​,σ2),
    where the means μ1​ and μ2​ and the variance σ2 are all unknown. Notice the assumption that the two distributions have the same variance. Also notice that there are n samples in the first group and m samples in the second.
  • Null hypothesis: μ1​=μ2​ (the values of μ1​ and μ2​ are not specified)

两组数据都来自正态分布, 并被假设具有相同的未知方差 σ2, 但均值可以不同. 样本量 n 与 m 不必相等.

原假设只写 μ1​=μ2​, 不需要指定共同均值是多少. 研究问题是比较两个均值, 而不是估计某一个均值本身.

Page 8
  • Test statistic:
    t=sp​xˉ−yˉ​​,
    where sp2​ is the pooled variance
    sp2​=n+m−2(n−1)sx2​+(m−1)sy2​​(n1​+m1​).
    Here sx2​ and sy2​ are the sample variances of the xi​ and yj​ respectively. The expression for t is somewhat complicated, but the basic idea remains the same and it still results in a known null distribution.
  • Null distribution: ϕ(t∣H0​) is the pdf of T∼t(n+m−2).
  • One-sided p-value (right side): p=P(T>t∣H0​)
    One-sided p-value (left side): p=P(T<t∣H0​)
    Two-sided p-value: p=P(∣T∣>∣t∣).

等方差双样本检验比较两组均值, 先用两组数据共同估计 σ2. 两组样本量可以不同, 合并时按各自自由度 n−1 和 m−1 加权, 总自由度为 n+m−2.

本讲记号的特别处:sp2​ 已乘 (1/n+1/m), 因此它是 Xˉ−Yˉ 的估计方差, 分母直接用 sp​.

前面按自由度加权得到的是共同总体方差的估计. 由于 Xˉ 的方差含 1/n, Yˉ 的方差含 1/m, 且两组独立, 均值差的方差要把这两部分相加.

这就解释了为什么后面还要乘 (1/n+1/m). 样本量越大, 均值差的标准误越小, 同样的效应就更容易检出.

Pages 8–9

Note 1: Some authors use a different notation. They define the pooled variance as

sp-other-authors2​=n+m−2(n−1)sx2​+(m−1)sy2​​

and what we called the pooled variance they point out is the estimated variance of xˉ−yˉ​. That is,

sp2​=sp-other-authors2​(1/n+1/m)≈sxˉ−yˉ​2​.

Note 2: There is a version of the two-sample t-test that allows the two groups to have different variances. In this case the test statistic is a little more complicated but R will handle it with equal ease.

Note 3: We reiterate our ‘important note’ from above: It can be proved that under the assumptions on the data (independent samples, normal data, equal variances), the null distribution is a t-distribution. We won’t prove this in 18.05. But knowing it, we can work with and understand the gist of the two-sample t-test in exactly the same way we can understand other significance tests.

其他教材若把合并总体方差记作 sp2​, 统计量常写成 (xˉ−yˉ​)/(sp​1/n+1/m​). 两种写法等价, 不能重复乘因子.

若两组方差不应视为相同, 应改用不等方差版本, 而不是强行套用本公式. 知道零分布后, 后续的临界值和 p 值流程仍与其他检验相同.

Example 3: 两种入院方式
Example 3.

Page 9

The following data comes from a real study in which 1408 women were admitted to a maternity hospital for (i) medical reasons or through (ii) unbooked emergency admission. The duration of pregnancy is measured in complete weeks from the beginning of the last menstrual period. We can summarize the data as follows:

Medical: 775 observations with xˉM​=39.08 and sM2​=7.77.
Emergency: 633 observations with xˉE​=39.60 and sE2​=4.95

Set up and run a two-sample t-test to investigate whether the mean duration differs for the two groups. What assumptions did you make?

Solution: The pooled variance for this data is

sp2​=1406774(7.77)+632(4.95)​(7751​+6331​)=0.0187.

The t statistic for the null distribution is

sp​xˉM​−yˉ​E​​=−3.8064.

双尾备择是 μM​=μE​. 按原文记号 sp2​≈0.0186626, sp​≈0.136611, 所以 t=(39.08−39.60)/sp​≈−3.80643, df=1406.

分子是均值差 −0.52 周, 分母是这个差的标准误. 检验问的是该差异相对于抽样波动是否足够大.

Page 9

We have 1406 degrees of freedom. Using R to compute the two-sided p-value we get

p=P(∣T∣>∣t∣)=2*pt(-3.8064, 1406)=0.00015.

p is very small, much smaller than α=0.05 or α=0.01. Therefore we reject the null hypothesis in favor of the alternative that there is a difference in the mean durations.

Rather than compute the two-sided p-value exactly using a t-distribution we could have noted that with 1406 degrees of freedom the t distribution is essentially standard normal and 3.8064 is almost 4 standard deviations. So

P(∣t∣≥3.8064)≈P(∣z∣≥3.8064)<0.001.

We assumed the data was normal and that the two groups had equal variances. Given the large difference between the sample variances this assumption may not be warranted. In fact, there are other significance tests that test whether the data is approximately normal and whether the two groups have the same variance. In practice one might apply these first to determine whether a t test is appropriate in the first place. We don’t have time to go into normality tests here, but we will see the F distribution used for equality of variances next week.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Normality_test
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/F-test_of_equality_of_variances

Python 数值积分给出双尾 p≈0.00014705, 与原文 0.00015 一致, 拒绝等均值假设. 大自由度下用标准正态近似也得到远小于 0.001 的尾概率.

模型警报:两组样本方差 7.77 和 4.95 差别明显, 等方差假设可能不合理. 统计显著也不自动说明差异有实际重要性, 还应看均值差及其置信区间.

大样本使很小的均值差也可能达到统计显著, 所以报告时不能只写 p<0.001. 本例均值差为 0.52 周, 是否有临床或实际意义需要结合背景判断.

若等方差条件不可信, 应考虑不等方差双样本方法, 而不是因为当前结果显著就忽略模型问题.

Slide 19
  • Data: x1​,…,xn​, y1​,…,ym​
  • Assume xi​ are independently drawn from N(μx​,σ2).
  • Assume yj​ are independently drawn from N(μy​,σ2). (Same σ)
  • Assume xi​ and yj​ are independent.
  • Null hypothesis H0​:μx​=μy​.
  • t-test: μx​,μy​,σ all unknown.
  • Pooled variance:
    sp2​=n+m−2(n−1)sx2​+(m−1)sy2​​(n1​+m1​).
  • Test statistic: t=sp​xˉ−yˉ​​.
  • Null distribution: ϕ(t∣H0​) is the pdf of T∼t(n+m−2)

幻灯片把独立条件写全: 每组内部独立, 两组之间也独立. 合并方差、统计量和 n+m−2 的零分布都与讲义一致.

Slide 19
  • In general (so we can compute power) we have
    sp​(xˉ−yˉ​)−(μx​−μy​)​∼t(n+m−2).
  • Note: there are more general formulas for unequal variances.

最后的中心化统计量减去真实均值差, 因而在一般正态等方差模型下服从中心 t 分布.

若直接在 HA​ 下研究未减均值差的 t=(xˉ−yˉ​)/sp​, 它相对零分布会有非零中心; 功效还取决于真实效应、共同方差和样本量.

显著性、基准率与发表错误
Significance, Base Rates and Published Errors

第一类错误讨论 Q1
Class discussion: Type I errors Q1

Slide 21

Suppose a journal will only publish results that are statistically significant at the 0.05 level. What percentage of the papers it publishes contain type I errors?

无法仅凭 0.05 确定. 问题问的是 P(H0​ 为真∣发表), 而显著性给的是 P(拒绝 H0​∣H0​), 条件方向相反.

还需要所有投稿中 H0​ 为真的基准率、各种备择下的功效, 以及投稿和发表选择机制. 已发表研究中第一类错误的比例可以在 0 到 100% 之间.

直觉上, 若几乎所有研究都面对真实无效的治疗, 只有少数假阳性被发表, 这些论文就几乎全错; 若大多数治疗真有效且功效很高, 发表论文中真阳性会占多数.

所以期刊只收显著结果会改变论文集合的构成. 不能用单次检验的 α 直接替代这个集合中的错误比例.

第一类错误讨论 Q2
Class discussion: Type I errors Q2

Slide 22

Jerry desperately wants to cure diseases but he is terrible at designing effective treatments. He is however a careful scientist and statistician, so he randomly divides his patients into control and treatment groups. The control group gets a placebo and the treatment group gets the experimental treatment. His null hypothesis H0​ is that the treatment is no better than the placebo. He uses a significance level of α=0.05. If his p-value is less than α he publishes a paper claiming the treatment is significantly better than a placebo.

(a) Since his treatments are never, in fact, effective what percentage of his experiments result in published papers?
(b) What percentage of his published papers contain type I errors, i.e. describe treatments that are no better than placebo?

(a) 所有试验的 H0​ 都为真, 在检验假设成立且达到名义水平时, 约 5% 会因假阳性而发表.

(b) 100%. 所有治疗都无效, 所以所有「显著优于安慰剂」的已发表结论都是第一类错误. 5% 是试验被发表的比例, 不是论文错误率.

可以把实验分成两类: 约 95% 没有显著结果、不会发表, 约 5% 假阳性、能够发表. 发表环节把大量正确的不拒绝结果过滤掉, 留下的论文自然全是错误结论.

第一类错误讨论 Q3
Class discussion: Type I errors: Q3

Slide 23

Jen is a genius at designing treatments, so all of her proposed treatments are effective. She is also a careful scientist and statistician, so she too runs double-blind, placebo controlled, randomized studies. Her null hypothesis is always that the new treatment is no better than the placebo. She also uses a significance level of α=0.05 and publishes a paper if p<α.

(a) How could you determine what percentage of her experiments result in publications?
(b) What percentage of her published papers contain type I errors, i.e. describe treatments that are, in fact, no better than placebo?

(a) 发表比例由功效决定. 需要知道真实效应、方差、样本量和检验方法; 效应很弱时发表率可接近 5%, 效应很强且功效接近 1 时可接近 100%.

(b) 0%. 所有治疗都确实有效, 拒绝「无效」这一 H0​ 不会构成第一类错误. 对比 Jerry 和 Jen 可见, 同一个 α 不能单独决定已发表论文的错误比例.

Jen 未发表的有效研究属于漏检, 不是第一类错误; 它们影响的是发表率和第二种错误, 不会改变已发表论文中「治疗实际无效」的比例.

这三问最终都在提醒: 检验的错误率与论文集的错误率是不同层次的问题, 发表选择会改变后者.
